newsitem.title: FRANCE: St-Gobain sees sales growth in Asia.
newsitem.headline: St-Gobain sees sales growth in Asia.

text.p: French building materials and glass-maker Saint-Gobain expects to see strong sales growth in Asia, which reached 2.9 billion francs in 1995, chairman Jean-Louis Beffa said on Friday.

"I maintain the sales target of five billion francs from Asia in 2000 and 20 billion in 2005...I am convinced we can double our sales in Japan in three years, particularly in industrial ceramics," he told an analysts meeting.
Within 10 years, the group's turnover will be split in quarters from between France, Europe, North America and Mexico, and Asia and Latin America.

Present operations should generate extra sales of 1.65 billion francs from South America, 650 million from Central America, one billion from eastern Europe, 300 million in north Asia, 70 million from south-east Asia, 900 million from China and 700 million from India, Beffa said.
Beffa noted the weakness of business in south-east Asia, adding that the company should focus on Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand.
"Asia is our growth area for the long term," he said.
